mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, s.name, s.goal, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate, s.status, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM sprint s LEFT JOIN project p ON s.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY s.start_date DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sprint (project_id, name, goal, start_date, end_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{goal}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
